rule: An identity is absent from the playable pool if and only if its maximum overall across all tournament cards is below 80. Every card of every retained identity remains playable.

summary.note: Playable 2026 cards below 80 belong to identities whose historical maximum is at least 80, so they are intentionally retained.

portraitAssets.note: No portrait file was deleted. Restored archive portraits remain available for reference verification and retained cards.
